job.title: Software Engineer II
job.pay_full: $106,000 – $169,000 a year base salary (Arlington, Virginia); may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role

details.about: Mastercard's Data & Analytics organization is looking for a Software Engineer II with experience building data-centric platforms. The role helps build a new enterprise data platform in its early stages while supporting an existing platform that securely moves data from Mastercard's environment into other environments. The team is evolving from data engineering toward platform engineering, working with product teams, consultants, analysts and engineering partners to make enterprise data easier to exchange, discover, access and use.
duties: Design, build and maintain scalable data-centric platforms, services and integrations across cloud and on-premises environments
Help develop a new enterprise data platform while supporting and improving the existing data movement platform
Develop and optimise data-intensive applications with Spark, Databricks and related technologies
Build backend services and APIs for data onboarding, exchange, discovery and consumption
Write clean, well-tested code and contribute to code reviews, CI/CD and engineering standards
Resolve performance, reliability and scalability issues across services, APIs and data processing
Join system design discussions and work with Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Security and business teams across time zones
needs: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals: object-oriented programming, API design, testing and scalable system design
Backend development experience with Java preferred; strong Python experience also considered
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark for data-processing workloads
Experience with cloud and cloud-native technologies; AWS and Databricks strongly preferred
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing and production support
Experience building or contributing to data-centric platforms, distributed systems or enterprise data integration
Strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills in an agile environment
nice: Front-end exposure such as React or Angular
Streaming technologies such as Kafka and Flink
Building reusable platforms that serve multiple products or teams
Exposure to integrating AI-driven capabilities into data platforms with governance and guardrails
details.benefits: Base salary $106,000 – $169,000 a year in Arlington, Virginia; the successful candidate may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. Benefits for full-time employees generally include medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; flexible spending and health savings accounts; 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave; 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 days of vacation and 5 personal days (pro-rated by hire date); 10 paid US holidays; a 401(k) with company match; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; and tuition reimbursement eligibility.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 01/21/2027 (or as soon as possible after that date)
